description: A bug tracker built with SvGrid Base for Svelte 5: Bugs and Releases as linked tables. Triage grouped by status, a Kanban board, a view of what is critical now, bugs by area, and a report form, with automations that flag critical bugs, stamp fix dates and start work from a button.

faq.question: What do the automations do?
faq.answer: A critical bug that is not fixed turns red and raises a notice; setting Status to Fixed stamps Fixed on with today; a bug sent with the form starts as New; Start in the Fix column moves a bug to In progress. Open 4 automations in the view bar to change them.

faq.question: Can it run on my database?
faq.answer: Yes. Give each table a source (baseSource over Postgres, Supabase or your API) and the base loads the records from it and writes every change back; or start from npm create @svgrid@latest -- -t base with your own tables.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
